chosen_route.height_note: 画面按10 cm低台阶设置生成；照片不替代真实高度测量。
chosen_route.descent: 身体始终朝向台阶，倒退下阶，左腿先下；s04左足地面、右足仍台面

identity_style.person: 同参考成年女性、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰裤、白色无品牌运动鞋
identity_style.background: 灰蓝棚拍、柔和光线、自然阴影

Her LEFT hand lightly contacts the horizontal rail with plausible fingers. Choose a clear diagonal side camera position so the supporting hand contact, the platform's top surface and edges and BOTH complete shoes can all be seen.

This exact environment, rail, platform, camera and person scale will be fixed for the next three steps.
Lighting: match references' soft photographic studio lighting and gray-blue color.
Constraints: SINGLE woman, SINGLE pose. Both whole shoes on floor before step; no foot on platform yet. Accurate anatomically continuous limbs and realistic handrail contact. No text, numerals, arrows, logos, watermark, collage or motion trails. Do not depict jumping, balancing on tiptoe, a tall stair or unsupported portable rail.
